description: Spacious and generous. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa in the lower-left living area facing inward toward the centre of the room; dining table with four chairs nearer the centre-right of the plan. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom in a corner position — potential exposure on two sides. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, 16 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: someone needing a dedicated home office with natural light; households requiring more than one bathroom; those wanting an ensuite master bedroom.
